column1: # Game profile of FIFA 18 (Switch, base game 1.0.0 = v0). Plays on the Mac from the base NSP: menus, kits and full matches at 60 fps with sound; the back buffer is raised to 2560x1440 docked (patches.py)
# EA's RNA renderer and SportsRNA on NVN, SDK 3.4.0: the shaders are GLSLC outputs in EA's encrypted BIG archives (data/fifarna/shader.big, shaderboot.big; dm/gfx/tools/eabig.py) and in main

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# every module main imports from (subsdk0 = GLSLC)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region (the NSP script's guess, kept: no allocation failure on the Mac through full matches)
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# used memory for the rewritten modules, at least the default 64 MB
# texcompface.fxo (the players' faces, composed at run time) picks one of 8 combined texture handles from the driver table (c2 0x20 + 8 × slot, slots 0-7) by its loop index,
# so the translator could not trace it to one slot; every other integer read of c2 there is a table slot (drv_reads 32-80)
